items.title: Dow Jones Futures Fall; Trump Says 'Not Too Late' For U.S. To Take Nvidia Stake
items.summary: Futures fell after AI stocks tumbled but medicals, retailers and more rose. President Trump mused about an Nvidia stake. Fed inflation data looms.

items.title: Workday Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
items.summary: Workday (NASDAQ:WDAY) raised its fiscal 2027 subscription revenue and operating margin forecasts after reporting third-quarter growth fueled in part by demand for artificial intelligence products. Subscription revenue rose 13% from a year earlier to $2.532 billion, while total revenue increased 11%

items.title: Workday Inc (WDAY) (Q3 2027) Earnings Call Highlights: AI Momentum Accelerates as ARR Tops $750 ...
items.summary: Workday Inc (WDAY) delivered strong AI-driven growth and margin expansion in Q3 2027, but flagged decelerating U.S. revenue and slower Q4 subscription growth ahead.

items.title: Workday’s AI Pivot and Earnings Beat Isn’t Enough to Lift Stock
items.summary: The stock has fallen more than 16% this year.

items.title: Workday Raises Full-Year Subscription Outlook After Sales Rise
items.summary: The human-resources platform raised its full-year subscription revenue outlook to $9.96 billion, up from its prior range of $9.94 billion to $9.95 billion.

items.title: Dell, HP, Autodesk and Workday earnings: what to watch today
items.summary: Investing.com -- All four report after the close today (Nov 24, 2026). Prices below are as of 3:36 PM EST. The hardware pair (Dell Tech (DELL) and HP Inc (HPQ)) is a bet on AI servers versus PC economics. The software pair (Autodesk (ADSK) and Workday (WDAY)) is about steady subscription compounding.

items.title: Workday (WDAY) Tops Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Workday (WDAY) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +2.92% and +0.56%, respectively, for the quarter ended October 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
